claims.claim: There is no single shelter exit timer. Under rocket fire the rule is at least 10 minutes; under ballistic missile fire there is no automatic timed exit and the instruction is to remain until an official all-clear arrives via the Home Front Command app and Cell Broadcast, because salvos arrive in sequence and interception fragments keep falling for minutes. The 10-minute line on the app alert screen is leftover wording from earlier operations.
claims.raw_snippet: נשארים במרחב מוגן או יוצאים אחרי 10 דקות? הבלבול המסוכן באפליקציית פיקוד העורף. בעוד שההנחיה הרשמית היא להישאר במרחב מוגן עד לקבלת הודעת שחרור רשמית באפליקציה ובמערכת ה-Cell Broadcast, במסך ההתרעה מוצגת הנחיה לשהות במרחב המוגן 10 דקות בלבד.

claims.claim: Israel has at least seven Level-1 trauma centers, and Ziv and Barzilai were additionally designated. No hospital is any longer the only Level-1 center in its region.
claims.raw_snippet: The Level 1 trauma centers in Israel include Rambam Medical Center in Haifa, Soroka Medical Center in Beersheba, and in the country's center: Sheba Medical Center, Ichilov Hospital and Beilinson Hospital in the greater Tel Aviv area, and Shaare Zedek Medical Center and Hadassah Medical Center in Jerusalem. The Health Ministry decided to recognize Ziv Medical Center in Safed and Barzilai Medical Center in Ashkelon as Level 1 trauma centers. Hospitals close to the borders, Ziv not far from Lebanon and Syria, and Barzilai near Gaza, must be able to handle life-threatening injuries.

claims.claim: The 2025 AHA and AAP pediatric guidelines removed the two-finger infant compression technique and recommend two thumbs-encircling hands or one-hand, with heel-of-one-hand when the rescuer cannot encircle the chest
claims.raw_snippet: For infants, the recommended compression techniques include using either the one-hand technique or the two thumbs-encircling hands technique. If the rescuer cannot physically encircle the chest, it is recommended to compress the chest with the heel of one-hand. The use of two fingers along the sternum was eliminated due to ineffectiveness in achieving proper depth. Published online October 22, 2025 in Circulation and Pediatrics.

claims.claim: The 2025 AHA adult BLS guidance is cycles of 5 back blows followed by 5 abdominal thrusts, with chest thrusts substituted when the person is pregnant or too large to reach around
claims.raw_snippet: For adults with severe foreign-body airway obstruction, rescuers should perform cycles of 5 back blows followed by 5 abdominal thrusts until the object is expelled or the patient becomes unresponsive. If the patient is pregnant or obese, perform five chest thrusts over the sternum instead.
